changes.title: Party start fx
items: Starting the party is a proper spectacle now: a tall column of light shoots up above the treetops, a glowing dome blooms round the decks, bigger and brighter amber and rose sparkles fly out, and it all shows over the treehouse instead of hiding under it.
Once the party's going, press E (square on a controller) at your decks to play the party-start show again. The DJ shouts "make some noise!!!"
Every piece of the party-start show has its own sliders and switches in the pause page, under Party start.

changes.title: Follower buffs
items: Adults on your leash now give you a buff by how their kind retreats: extra dashes, faster movement, further-flying invites, shots both ways, faster firing or chaining invites
Different kinds stack; two of the same kind count once. A legend on your leash counts as three
An adult's buff runs on berries: up to five pips, two minutes each, shown beside its sigil. Lead it past berries to keep it going
Each buff shows an icon beside its animal's sigil, and the chain to a buffing animal glows

changes.title: Landscape potions
items: Ten new mushroom recipes make trees walk or tower, turn bark and light loose across the forest, reveal the canopy cutaway, and let the island bend and breathe with the wave.

changes.title: Film contours
items: Brew Silent Film for a scratched sepia film with a narrow soundtrack, or Contour Dream to see coloured height lines across the island and its animals. Folded Space lets you walk across giant creases in the landscape.

changes.title: Creature spell visibility
items: Creatures' spells are much easier to see: their bolts, hits, scorch marks, quakes, lingering puddles and beams are bigger, brighter and glow more, and last a little longer
The unicorn's beam is a real rainbow now, and the sphinx's gaze is gold
Creature spells can be tuned on the pause page (Creature spells: size, opacity, glow, duration, zone density, ground marks)

changes.title: Anchor chains
items: Adults on your leash are anchors: you can roam about 30 m from each, and at the end of its chain you can't go further until it catches up
You can't take off with an adult on your leash: put its sigil down first
A chain at its full length goes taut and glows

changes.title: Treehouse step off
items: Stepping off the treehouse with your broom now takes off straight from the floor: no more dropping down and rising again, and the camera stays steady as you fly away.

changes.title: Pause pane scrollbars
items: Pause settings stay together on the left, with gold scrollbars at the outer edges of both panes.

changes.title: Path variants
items: Footpaths come in several looks each (worn or rutted dirt, laid or sunken flagstones, setts or river cobbles, sound or gappy boardwalks and more), so neighbouring paths look different
Paths have bump maps: stones, cobbles, planks and roots stand out, lit on the side facing the moon or your glow (a slider on the pause page under Paths)
Animal tracks, magic trails and stepping stones are easier to see at night, and root paths no longer look striped

changes.title: Path network
items: Footpaths now link every area's stump to the stumps of all the areas next to it (and to the dancefloor), going round lakes; no trees grow on them
Footpaths have long straight stretches and gentle curves instead of zig-zags
Tonight's find is in an area of its own (never next to home), at its middle on a little clearing, where the paths lead; that area has no stump and no creatures
Stumps are never closer than 40 m to each other

changes.title: Four potions
items: Masterplan reveals animal destinations, pack formations and attack aims. Brew Mirrorball for a mirror moon that scatters light across the forest, Woodcut for an ink print, or Kaleidoscope for six mirrored views around the witch.
